    How the bill adds up

    Each card converts its everyday input—hours, showers, loads, sessions or distance—into monthly energy. The basic model is rated watts × operating factor × usage × quantity. In ToU mode, the typical start time splits energy between weekday peak and off-peak rates; weekends are treated as off-peak. Other tariff components apply to the whole month's kWh.
